name: Rosewood Doha
insider_take: Where ultra-modern luxury meets timeless Arabian elegance in Qatar's cultural heart.
whats_special: Rosewood Doha stands as an architectural marvel on Al Maryah Island, featuring a stunning 47-story tower designed by renowned architect Jean-Michel Gathy. The hotel showcases Qatar's largest collection of contemporary Middle Eastern art and offers panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf. Its location provides direct access to Doha's Museum of Islamic Art and the vibrant Souq Waqif, while the property itself houses the city's highest rooftop pool.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 30+ for unobstructed views of the Doha skyline and Persian Gulf, especially stunning during sunset when the city's futuristic architecture glows golden.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant Niraam offers modern Indian cuisine with Gulf views, while the Sense Spa features traditional hammam treatments. Take the complimentary yacht shuttle to explore Doha's coastline, and don't miss the nearby National Museum of Qatar with its distinctive rose-shaped architecture designed by Jean Nouvel.
pros: Ultra-luxurious accommodations with sophisticated Middle Eastern design
Prime waterfront location with stunning Doha skyline and Arabian Gulf views
World-class dining experiences featuring international and regional cuisine
Extensive wellness facilities including spa and state-of-the-art fitness center
cons: Located in business district, requires travel to reach cultural attractions
